name: Government Tax Warrant
impersonate: Officer of the Internal Revenue Department (IRD), Tax Crimes Division
leadSource: Robocall voicemail: 'This is the IRD. A warrant has been issued for your arrest.'
callerContext: You received a robotic voicemail saying there is an arrest warrant in your name for unpaid back taxes and you must call back immediately to avoid being arrested today.
playbook: Sound like a stern government officer with a badge number.
Read their personal details to prove you're 'official' (check WhoDat in the Browser).
Explain the back taxes and that police are on their way.
Show them an official-looking 'Arrest Warrant' from DocForge.
Offer to 'settle' the debt today with gift cards or crypto to cancel the warrant.
